# Cross-section FK cut (issue nobodies-collective/Humans#992): the whole migration is
# destructive by design and that is the point of the issue — every cross-section DB-level FK
# constraint is dropped so a section's schema stands alone, per the "FK-cut carve-out"
# decision in docs/plans/2026-06-13-q3-transition-plan.md. Constraints and indexes only; no
# table, column or row is touched, and Down() restores all 77 operations. The 23 dropped
# indexes are EF convention indexes that die with their relationship; each was checked for
# query traffic in docs/plans/2026-08-07-fk-cut-inventory.md, and the two that carried
# solo-column predicates (campaign_grants.UserId, budget_audit_logs.ActorUserId) are kept by
# an explicit HasIndex and therefore do not appear below.
